How it works

Up and cooking in 3 steps

1

Open your app

Download the PDF in your Etsy order and open your Recipe Library Studio link. Install it like an app: the install icon in Chrome or Edge, or Share → Add to Home Screen on iPhone.

2

Add your recipes

Paste a recipe link, paste up to 100 links at once, paste a whole recipe page, or type in family favorites.

3

Plan, shop and cook

Drop recipes into your week, send the ingredients to your shopping list, then cook step by step with built-in timers.

Print & make it yours

Print it beautifully.

Recipe cards, meal plans and shopping lists in Letter or A4, and a recipe book with a designer cover.
